composition.pillarAllTaboo: A named 諸事皆忌 pillar clause makes every heading only_ji.
composition.ji: 忌 noted if any modeled scope keeps 忌 (only_ji/both_present) or the heading is the day's 百忌.
composition.yiSuppressors: 宜 not noted if any scope that lists the heading is 從忌不從宜 (as_usual/still_avoid/avoid_all) or 不註 (neither_recorded), or a 鋪註 07–10 line applies.
composition.neither: neither_recorded only when a scope records 不註 (相抵) and no protected 忌 remains (鋪註 05).
composition.liftedInference: A 止忌 scope reporting undetermined while 宜 is known false can only be a lifted 忌 (not_avoided).
composition.notRecorded: not_recorded: nothing noted and no scope says 不註 (e.g. 宜 known absent, 忌 lifted or never listed).
composition.undetermined: Any scope still undetermined for the heading, or unknown 宜 where 宜 would decide, leaves the day state undetermined.
composition.completeness: Only the 13 卷十 subjects, pillar clauses and 百忌 are modeled; 卷十一 忌 gods outside them are reported as unmodeled (present/unknown), and the day result is partial when any is present or unknown.

propagation.trigger: from-heading is neither_recorded by 相抵
propagation.effect: to-heading's 忌 is not noted unless it is protected (百忌, 止忌 list = 遇德猶忌, pillar 諸事皆忌); single pass over the composed day
